theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_cfs_cc_imrep_vanish_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents X → (∀ γ : TestFormOn U n, (∀ x ∈ R.carrier, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = 0) → X γ = 0) ∧ (R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∀ (γ : TestFormOn U n) (b : ℝ), (∀ x, ‖(γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ b) → |X γ| ≤ (R.measure univ).toReal * b)
